kurals.tr: Aatruvaar Aatral Ikazhaamai Potruvaar / Potralul Ellaam Thalai
kurals.m: Not to disregard the power of those who can carry out (their wishes) is more important than all the watchfulness of those who guard (themselves against evil)

kurals.tr: Periyaaraip Penaadhu Ozhukir Periyaaraal / Peraa Itumpai Tharum
kurals.m: To behave without respect for the great (rulers) will make them do (us) irremediable evils

kurals.tr: Ketalventin Kelaadhu Seyka Atalventin / Aatru Pavarkan Izhukku
kurals.m: If a person desires ruin, let him not listen to the righteous dictates of law, but commit crimes against those who are able to slay (other sovereigns)

kurals.tr: Kootraththaik Kaiyaal Viliththatraal Aatruvaarkku / Aatraadhaar Innaa Seyal
kurals.m: The weak doing evil to the strong is like beckoning Yama to come (and destroy them)

kurals.tr: Yaantuch Chendru Yaantum Ularaakaar / Vendhuppin Vendhu Serappat Tavar
kurals.m: Those who have incurred the wrath of a cruel and mighty potentate will not prosper wherever they may go

kurals.tr: Eriyaal Sutappatinum Uyvuntaam Uyyaar / Periyaarp Pizhaiththozhuku Vaar
kurals.m: Though burnt by a fire (from a forest), one may perhaps live; (but) never will he live who has shown disrespect to the great (devotees)

kurals.tr: Vakaimaanta Vaazhkkaiyum Vaanporulum Ennaam / Thakaimaanta Thakkaar Serin
kurals.m: If a king incurs the wrath of the righteous great, what will become of his government with its splendid auxiliaries and (all) its untold wealth ?

kurals.tr: Kundrannaar Kundra Madhippin Kutiyotu / Nindrannaar Maaivar Nilaththu
kurals.m: If (the) hill-like (devotees) resolve on destruction, those who seemed to be everlasting will be destroyed root and branch from the earth

kurals.tr: Endhiya Kolkaiyaar Seerin Itaimurindhu / Vendhanum Vendhu Ketum
kurals.m: Kings even fall from high estate and perish in the flame

kurals.tr: Irandhamaindha Saarputaiyar Aayinum Uyyaar / Sirandhamaindha Seeraar Serin
kurals.m: Though in possession of numerous auxiliaries, they will perish who are-exposed to the wrath of the noble whose penance is boundless
